==Biography==
==={{OoT|-}}===
Sheik reveals himself to [[Link]] shortly after Link is freed from the [[Chamber of Sages]] after his seven-year slumber.<ref name="OoT3D Sheik"/> He introduces himself as the "survivor of the Sheikah".<ref name="OoT3D Sheik 2"/> He informs Link that he must awaken the [[Seven Sages]] in order to bring peace back to [[Hyrule]].<ref name="OoT3D Sheik 3"/> Alerting him of the need to acquire the [[Hookshot]] in order to enter the Temples, Sheik stays in front of the [[Pedestal of the Master Sword]].<ref name="OoT3D Sheik 4"/> He later appears when Link arrives at the [[Sacred Forest Meadow]]. He tells Link about the [[Song]]s for [[Warping]] that can access Temple entrances and teaches him the "[[Minuet of Forest]]" before disappearing again.<ref name="OoT3D Sheik 5"/> Further along, Sheik approaches Link at the [[Fire Temple (Ocarina of Time)|Fire Temple]] entrance in the [[Death Mountain Crater]], teaching him the [[Bolero of Fire]] before walking away, using a wall of flame to halt Link's inquiring advance.<ref name="OoT3D Sheik 6"/>

Sheik once again mysteriously appears in the [[Ice Cavern]] to inform Link of the fate of the [[Zora]]s and to teach him the "[[Serenade of Water]]".<ref name="OoT3D Sheik 7"/><ref name="OoT3D Sheik 8"/> He then waits outside the [[Water Temple (Ocarina of Time)|Water Temple]] for Link to free it from [[Morpha]]'s influence and awaken the [[Princess Ruto|Sage of Water]] before disappearing once again.

When [[Kakariko Village]] comes under attack from a mysterious force, Link discovers that Sheik is already there. Together they encounter and are defeated by an invisible monster thought to be the [[Bongo Bongo|Evil Shadow Spirit]]. Sheik teaches Link the "[[Nocturne of Shadow]]" and urges Link to help [[Impa]] fight the Evil Shadow Spirit.<ref name="OoT Sheik 2"/> When Link discovers that he must venture back in time in order to do so, Sheik offers a helping hand informing Link on how to use the [[Master Sword]] and the [[Pedestal of the Master Sword]] in order to travel back and forth through [[Time]].<ref name="OoT Sheik 3"/> He teaches Link the "[[Prelude of Light]]" before vanishing once again.<ref name="OoT Sheik 4"/>

At the entrance of the [[Spirit Temple (Ocarina of Time)|Spirit Temple]], Sheik appears to have been waiting for Link from atop a large rock formation and once again informs him that he must enter the Temple as a child, utilizing the Pedestal of the Master Sword in the [[Temple of Time]].<ref name="OoT Sheik 5"/> He gives Link a lesson on performing the "[[Requiem of Spirit]]" before using the desert winds as cover to vanish.<ref name="OoT Sheik 6"/>

With all Six Sages freed, Link is instructed to return to the Temple of Time where Sheik awaits. Sheik congratulates Link on his efforts and offers an explanation on what happened to [[Hyrule]] during Link's disappearance before finally revealing his true identity as [[Princess Zelda]].<ref name="OoT3D Sheik 9"/><ref name="OoT3D Princess Zelda 2"/>

==Other Appearances==
==={{OoT|-}} (Himekawa)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
[[File:OoT (Himekawa) Sheik Artwork.png|thumb|right|150px|{{Game Label|{{OoT (Himekawa)|Display}}}}Sheik's mouth uncovered]]
In the {{OoT (Himekawa)}}, Sheik first appears to [[Link]] having tended his wounds after being defeated by [[Volvagia]]. He is a spy for [[Ganondorf]] and later shows up to tell Link of a rumor that Princess Zelda had been spotted in the [[Desert of Illusions]], before vanishing again. On Link's way through the Desert, he nearly succumbs to blistering sands before Sheik pulls him out and continues to travel with him. Later that night, Link is attacked by illusions and images of his past, but Sheik is unaffected; Link wonders if it could be due to a lack of past in Sheik's life. Upon reaching the [[Gerudo's Fortress]], Sheik knocks Link out, and the Hero is captured.

Once Link frees himself, he fights through the ranks of the Gerudo, before Sheik comes to him with his Sword and Shield. Throwing them to Link, Sheik attacks the invisible [[Twinrova]], who were watching nearby. They accuse Sheik of being a traitor. Sheik is knocked unconscious after rebuking the accusation.

After escaping with the unconscious Sheik, Link finds a cave to rest in. He leaves to find water, flustered after getting too close to Sheik. He returns to find that Sheik, having awoken with the face wrappings off, appears to be a woman. Fully transforming, Sheik is revealed to be Princess Zelda, who later explains that she had Impa lock her consciousness away and assume the disguise of a Sheikah boy.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{SSBM|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Hatnote|See {{ssb|Main Page|SmashWiki's}} article on {{ssb|Sheik}} for more information.}}
[[File:SSBM Sheik Render.png|right|90px]]
[[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] has the option of transforming into Sheik by pressing down the Stick while holding the B Button. Sheik has a completely different moveset than Zelda that are not based on magic, as her moves and weapons are quick and similar to those of a ninja.

{{#section:Trophies in Super Smash Bros. Melee|Sheik}}
|}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{SSBB|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Sheik appears again in {{SSBB}}. Although she did not appear in {{TP}}, the character model was based on a design drafted during the game's development.<ref name="Super Smash Bros. DOJO!!"/> {{HH}} contains designs of {{TP|-}} Zelda as she would appear as Sheik, drawn specifically for {{SSBB|-}}.<ref name="HH 174"/>

She has mostly the same moveset from {{SSBM|-}}, and shares a [[Final Smash]] with Zelda, the [[Light Arrow]]s, although Sheik's deals more damage. In addition, Sheik can now {{ssb|crawl}}, {{ssb|wall jump}}, and use her Chain move as a {{ssb|tether recovery}}.

In [[The Subspace Emissary]] mode from {{SSBB|-}}, Sheik is first introduced after {{ssb|Solid Snake}} saves Zelda and Peach when they are captured inside the {{ssb|Halberd}}. Although he orders them to stay put, Zelda transforms into Sheik to escape along with Peach to the battleship's front deck. Eventually, they reach their destination when suddenly {{lw|Fox}} in his {{lw|Arwing}} destroys one of the airship's turrets, shooting near where Peach was walking. Thinking that Fox was aiming at Peach, Sheik teleports onto Fox's Arwing and, using her hand, shatters the cockpit window. This forces Fox to eject out of the Arwing and land on the battleship's front deck along with Sheik. Although the two begin to fight, Peach stops them by offering a cup of tea to Fox. Confused at first, Fox looks over to see that Sheik has already begun drinking the tea, thus realizing that Sheik and Peach are not his enemies as he accepts Peach's offer and joins them.

{{SSBTrophy|SSBB|header=yes}}
{{#section:Trophies in Super Smash Bros. Brawl|Sheik}}
|}

{{SSBSticker|header=yes}}
{{#section:Sticker|Sheik}}
|}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{HW|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
[[File:SheikHW.jpg|thumb|right|220px|{{Game Label|{{HW|-}}}}Sheik playing the Goddess's Harp]]
Sheik appears as a playable character in {{HW}}. She appears in the story when Zelda goes missing. Unlike her previous incarnations, Sheik does not go to great lengths to hide her feminine physique.

Sheik uses a Harp as her primary weapon, with which she can unleash elemental effects from, as well as playing the "[[Song of Storms]]" along with the other Songs for Warping from {{OoT|-}}. As Sheik performs combo attacks, an elemental Song note will appear beneath her [[Special Attack Gauge]]. The notes allows Sheik to perform different charge attacks based on the element, which is done by hitting her Strong Attack button (Strong I). These notes do not have a time limit and will go away if Strong I is hit. A different Strong Combo will switch it out.
* The note Sheik gets from her Strong II Combo is for "[[Serenade of Water]]"; it surrounds Sheik in a shield of Bottled Water that can absorb up to four Hearts worth of damage.
* The note Sheik gets from her Strong III Combo is for "[[Bolero of Fire]]"; it creates a fire glyph that explodes into a flame geyser with a delayed detonation. 
* The note Sheik gets from her Strong IV Combo is for "Song of Storms"; it produces an electric whirlwind that surrounds Sheik even while moving.
* The note Sheik gets from her Strong V Combo is for "[[Nocturne of Shadow]]s"; it produces a field of [[Darkness]] that paralyzes enemies and damages them. 
* The note Sheik gets from her Strong VI Combo is for "[[Prelude of Light]]"; it creates a rectangular field of Light that will regenerate her Special Attack Gauge when standing in it. 

When activating [[Focus Spirit]], Sheik performs "[[Saria's Song]]". When deactivating it in front of a group of enemies with the A button, sprouts grow from the ground and suddenly burst into Trees. Sheik's [[Special Attack]] has her strum her Harp in rhythm, causing a huge wave of notes on surrounding enemies. She also uses a kunai for basic, quick attacks.

Sheik is later revealed to be Zelda in disguise during "[[The Water Temple]]".<ref name="HW Sheik"/> She had been in disguise to protect her identity from the enemy forces. From this point in the game, Sheik and Zelda both become options for [[Scenario]]s. If either Sheik or Zelda are selected as Warriors, Ruto will take Zelda's place as leader of the Hyrulean Army.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{SSB4|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Sheik returns in {{SSB4}} as a separate character, no longer being a transformation of Zelda. Due to this, several new special moves exclusive to the {{SSB|-}} series were added to both characters' movesets. These include the '''Burst Grenade''' and '''Bouncing Fish''' for Sheik, and the {{ssb|Phantom Slash}} for Zelda.

{{SSBTrophy|SSB4|header=yes}}
{{#section:Trophies in Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS/Wii U|Sheik}}
|}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{SSBU|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In {{SSBU}}, Sheik appears in a redesign based off the [[Stealth Set]] from {{BotW}} with all of her basic move set from {{SSB4|-}} but with a different [[Final Smash]]. Sheik also appears as a [[Fighter Spirit]] that can be obtained by either clearing "[[Masquerade]]", Sheik's [[Classic Mode]] Route, or by purchasing it from the [[Shop]] for G 300.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==Trivia==
* Although Sheik does not appear in {{BotW}} or {{TotK}}, the [[Stealth Chest Guard]] and [[Stealth Tights]] appear to be based on his design. [[Sheik's Mask]] can also appear if the Sheik [[amiibo]] is used. His outfit from {{SSBU}} is also based directly off the Stealth Chest Guard and Stealth Tights, while his mask incorporates the [[Stealth Mask]]'s white scarf.
